title: A module's write kinds (spec §5.2), each <module>.<kind>, executed by its providers.executor (executor@1). scripts/modules.ts writeKinds enforces it; any other field is a compile error.

args.description: a strict JSON Schema in the module for the args its plan returns

floor.description: the lowest tier; the instance may raise it (writes.<kind>.floor), plan may raise a request

panel.description: a second reviewer of another model family must approve too

filed_by.description: other modules that may file this kind (the owning module consents): a module identity files a kind of another module only when it is listed here

binds.description: a head-bound write (a review post on one commit): the target fields it acts on (repo, ref, commit). Staleness is judged on these alone, so a redeployed executor, a moved base or other text on the pull request never stales a post whose head stands; every other kind keeps full revalidation.

card.description: {{name}} templates over the plan's args, facts and card values; rendered by the kernel

tools.description: write or destructive tools of the module's own connections routed into this kind by the proxy
